trajectory.reasoning:
To determine the orientation of three points $p, q, r$, we calculate the signed area of the triangle formed by them, which is proportional to the cross product of vectors $\vec{pq}$ and $\vec{qr}$.

The formula for the orientation is:
$\text{val} = (q.x - p.x) \cdot (r.y - q.y) - (q.y - p.y) \cdot (r.x - q.x)$

- If $\text{val} > 0$, the orientation is a left turn (counter-clockwise).
- If $\text{val} < 0$, the orientation is a right turn (clockwise).
- If $\text{val} = 0$, the points are collinear.
